cases.title: Bewdley post-installation field study
cases.kind: Observed post-flood package outcomes, resident self-report
cases.finding: 28 of 29 respondents reported lower flood impact after varied PFR packages.
cases.limitations: Selected respondents, uncontrolled packages, no transferable per-product effect or success probability.

cases.title: Defra post-installation effectiveness evaluation
cases.finding: Operation, maintenance and independent survey quality affect package performance.
cases.limitations: Mixed measures and sites; cannot attribute a causal effect to one product.

cases.title: Defra FD2657 property protection appraisal
cases.finding: Historical appraisal models protection packages using assigned reliability inputs.
cases.limitations: Model assumptions and historical costs are not observed current product outcomes.

cases.title: EA/Defra FloodReady: Gas Street, Sandiacre
cases.kind: Documented installation case; no post-flood outcome
cases.finding: A 53-home affordable housing development added passive PFR during construction after reviewing updated flood risk information.
cases.limitations: New-build installation case, not a retrofit effect evaluation or measured avoided loss.

cases.title: Flood Re Quinquenial Review 2024
cases.finding: Reports Build Back Better adoption and claims experience, and cites resilient reinstatement research.
cases.limitations: Programme uptake and modelled repair costs do not identify causal product performance. No insurance eligibility or grant is inferred.
